name: pose-fill
description: A pose fill, with the fixtures' stand-in engine in place of the optional helper (ac_posefill::stand_in): it holds key A's pose and moves the root in a straight line from key A's root to key B's, so the numbers can be worked out by hand. posefill.helper reports the stand-in, loaded, its plan built. Keys of yours stand at frame 0 (root offset z 0.9450101) and frame 30 (z 1.9450101). posefill.fill with the playhead on 12 fills the gap 0-30 in one call: 29 AI keys tagged "posefill", and frame 15 is halfway, z = (0.9450101 + 1.9450101) / 2 = 1.4450101; key 0 has no frames before it, so the result says the first context pose was repeated to make the model's 4. One undo step takes every AI key away (keys 0 and 30 stay) and redo brings them back. A key of yours on 60 (z 2.9450101) makes a 60-frame stretch 0-60, over the model's 58 frames in one call, so from 0 to 60 chains two calls through the key on 30 (58 AI keys): frame 45 is halfway along the second, z = (1.9450101 + 2.9450101) / 2 = 2.4450101. Raising the key on 60 to z 3.0 leaves the fill 30-60 as it was and says so, naming posefill.fill. Keys of yours on 62 and 200 are for the refusals: 60-62 (2 frames, under the model's 18) and 62-200 (138 frames, over its 58, with no key inside to aim for) are refused with the limits, from 30 to 200 is refused at the short gap 60-62 before anything is made, from without to, to before from, and frames that are not keys of yours (0 and 5) are refused, as is a target root the stand-in answers with numbers that are not finite ([9, 9, 9] on frame 230, gap 200-230) or one frame short ([8, 8, 8] on frame 260, gap 230-260). posefill.helper's unknown action fly and posefill.install's start (the stand-in installs nothing) are refused too. Every refusal leaves the animation as it was.

notes: key 0 has fewer than 3 frames before it: the first context pose was repeated to make the model's 4
made by the fixtures' stand-in, not the model
30-60: the motion made from poses was left as it was; make it again (posefill.fill) to meet the changed key
